# LazyTopper
> Human-grade AI tutor for CBSE Class 10 Maths and Science.

## Main URLs
- Home: https://lazytopper.app/
- TopicHub: https://lazytopper.app/topic-hub
- Trends: https://lazytopper.app/trends/10/Maths
- HPQ: https://lazytopper.app/highly-probable/10/Maths
- Predictive Papers: https://lazytopper.app/predictive-papers
- Practice: https://lazytopper.app/practice/10/Maths

## Core Capabilities
- Human-like tutoring flow (Teach, checkpoints, hints, next-step guidance)
- Chapter-wise trends for focused preparation
- Highly Probable Questions (HPQ) for exam-oriented drilling
- Predictive papers for timed board-style rehearsal
- Guided Learn -> Grind -> Practice -> Master loop

## Audience
Primary audience: Class 10 CBSE students (India), especially Maths and Science board preparation.
